messages:
maria: Quick design check on the batch vectors preview + rerank flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/GHI789 (frame: 'Preview + Rerank compact'). Need opinions on export placement, keyboard order, and small-screen behavior. @ryan @jamal

ryan: I think export should live in an above-table toolbar, left-aligned. Current header placement overlaps column labels on narrow widths. Toolbar can collapse into a kebab at <720px.

alex: Sticky toolbar is fine but watch virtualization; putting toolbar outside the scroller avoids sticky-in-virtual-list issues. Also we should ensure the export menu has aria attributes.

jamal: A11y: tab order wrong now — export is after preview cards. Export must be reachable first. Relevance badges need text alternatives (e.g., 'High relevance') and better contrast for purple. Add aria-live polite for rerank completion messages.

olivia: Product: CSV must contain batch_id, item_index, original_text, vector_id, similarity_score, and rerank_rank. Modal should explain rerank_rank is 1 = highest. Also for big batches (>5k) show sampled preview and run full rerank in background with notification.

maria: Microcopy proposals: change button to 'Export results (CSV)', rerank CTA to 'Rerank by similarity', tooltip for similarity: 'Cosine similarity (0–1)'. Place shortcut hints in tooltip (E = export).

design-bot: Accessibility scan: missing aria-labels on preview icons; recommend role="button" aria-haspopup on menu toggles; add focus outline token.

ryan: Implementation plan: prototype sticky toolbar + kebab collapse, wire 'e' shortcut for export, shift+R for rerank. Add focus trap for export modal and ensure export is first tabbable element.

alex: I'll land a quick CSS patch to prevent header overlap while the toolbar is queued. Ryan, I'll coordinate on virtual list edge cases.

jamal: I'll draft the a11y notes (focus order, screen reader announcements, badge text).

maria: Decisions: 1) Move export to above-table toolbar labelled 'Export results (CSV)'. 2) Toolbar collapses to kebab on <720px. 3) Keyboard shortcut 'E' for export; ensure tabindex order places export before preview cards. 4) Add aria-live polite announcements and textual relevance badges. 5) Sample preview for >5k rows, background rerank otherwise inline if <500ms.

olivia: I'll create the acceptance criteria ticket covering CSV schema, telemetry, and background rerank notifications.

maria: Thanks — drop PR and prototype links here when ready. Closing until prototype review. :rocket:
